- If it’s a self-drive rental, it should ideally have a black number plate with yellow letters. (Indian Motor Vehicle laws) You can get a fine upto 5k if caught by Traffic Police, No insurance can be claimed, if you meet an accident.
- If it’s a white plate, that means it’s registered as a private vehicle, and technically, renting or driving it as a rental is illegal under Indian Motor Vehicle laws.

Sorry, Team Drive Yourself, you should have told this to me upfront, I am not using your services.
